sources.note: Main product page. Describes AXEIUM as multi-specialty EHR/PM for community health centers supporting medical, dental, vision, and behavioral health. Lists grant-funded consortium origins and participating health centers.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Full certification details, pricing model (hybrid client-hosted with monthly subscription + visit-based SaaS), required third-party software (MDToolbox for Direct messaging, Paubox for secure email), all 26+ certified criteria listed.
Detailed ONC certification information page with certificate number, criteria, and dates.

Medical module feature page. Detailed descriptions of vitals, exam templates, CDS, problem lists, medications, allergies, labs, immunizations, surveys, health maintenance, SOAP notes, document repository, drawings.
Dental module feature page. Tooth charting, periodontal charting, treatment plans, CDT coding, imaging integration with DEXIS and Planmeca Romexis.
Additional dental module details and benefits description.
Vision module feature page. Refraction, anterior/posterior segment, tonometry, gonioscopy, drawings and annotations.
Behavioral health module feature page. Assessments, intake forms, SIRP workflow, treatment planning, group therapy.
EHI export documentation. Tab-separated file format using native record layout, separate handling for rich text and images. Notes scope varies by deployment.
Certified lab interfaces: Quest Diagnostics, LabCorp (ICD-10 certified), Meditech (custom integration for hospital-sponsored labs).
10 testimonials from community health center staff across Southern California including La Amistad, The Gary Center, Share Our Selves, Camino Health Center, etc.
Real World Testing results posted annually since 2022, covering Application Access, CQMs, Direct Messaging, Transition of Care, and VDT.
Office location: 1528 Brookhollow Dr, Suite 250, Santa Ana, CA 92705.
EMR directory listing: 4/5 stars (2 reviews), base price $146/month. Positive feedback on customization and dental charting.
EMR directory listing: 4/5 stars (4 reviews). Reviewers from South Boston CHC, LBU Community Clinic, Hazelton Medical Practice, North Florida Medical Associates. Positive on integrations and mobile.
LA City WBE certification for Brilogy Corporation. Categories: Computer Systems Design, Custom Programming, Employment/Temp Staffing. WBE since 2007, owner Julie Allione.
Business park directory confirming AXEIUM/Brilogy office at Brookhollow Business Park, Santa Ana, CA.
